rows.note: This is the all-purpose equivalent for unusually early physical, biological, or emotional maturity.

example.english: That girl started showing signs of puberty so young; she is truly precocious.
example.traditional: 個女仔咁細個就開始有青春期徵狀，真係早熟。
example.jyutping: go3 neoi5 zai2 gam3 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 jau5 cing1 ceon1 kei4 zing1 zong6 zan1 hai6 zou2 suk6

rows.jyutping: sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 sik1 V
rows.note: Use this colloquial pattern when a child masters a particular skill unusually young.

example.english: My son was precocious with the piano and could play quite well at a very young age.
example.traditional: 阿仔細細個就識彈琴，仲彈得幾好添。
example.jyutping: aa3 zai2 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 sik1 taan4 kam4 zung6 taan4 dak1 gei2 hou2 tim1

rows.note: Use this more precise written term for a child whose intellectual abilities develop exceptionally early.

example.english: That child is intellectually precocious and could already understand high-school-level books at six.
example.traditional: 嗰位小朋友天資早慧，六歲已經睇得明高中程度嘅書。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 siu2 pang4 jau5 tin1 zi1 zou2 wai6 luk6 seoi3 ji5 ging1 tai2 dak1 ming4 gou1 zung1 cing4 dou6 ge3 syu1
